referenceFunction.generalComment: Data are based on information from a recent dismantling study of various consumer electronics; UUID: 43f7e2c2-abd2-3f86-b3e3-c695159f8bb1
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset for the OLED screen is assumed to have equivalent the bill of materials as the LED screen monitors, according to the other dismantling studies (source: Babbitt et al., 2020; Peeters et al., 2012). However, the module type is specifically adapted using OLED based modules - which is modeled in a separate dataset. The average size of the modeled OLED monitor is 43 inches, with a total weight of approximately 9.3 kg. The model is based on the actual product LG smart TV 43" 43UH610A-UJ (LG, 2016). The monitor comprises metals (copper, steel), plastics (ABS), PCB, and flat panel glass, whose weight shares are defined from the bill of materials data from Babbitt et al., 2020.
